paths.description: Modern portal entry and service-directory template; primary orientation surface.
Process-services listing; represents a major service-category/detail template.
Jurisprudence listing; represents a second service category and navigation state.
First-instance judgment query and result journey; distinct legacy form/results archetype.
Representative unknown route to test HTTP failure and recovery.

findings.summary: The portal does not follow the user’s dark colour preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-emulated screenshot is visually identical to the light capture, and the CSS probe found no prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface, text, border and icon tokens.

findings.summary: Text contrast and accessible naming fall below an inclusive baseline.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports color-contrast, heading-order and visible-label/accessibility-name failures on the modern portal; the legacy search scores 0.70 for accessibility.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct token contrast to WCAG AA and align each control’s accessible name with its visible label.

findings.summary: Service navigation swaps content abruptly without preserving spatial context.
findings.evidence: CSS/DOM probing found no view-transition usage while representative service selections replace the main content.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions for service changes and suppress non-essential motion under reduced motion.

findings.summary: Navigation chrome does not respond to page position or guide attention through long pages.
findings.evidence: Desktop screenshots show a static header/sidebar; the probe found no container-query support and representative navigation changes have no attention cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add position-aware sticky chrome or a lightweight progress/orientation affordance, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: The legacy first-instance judgment search is a desktop canvas scaled down on phones.
findings.evidence: At a requested 360px viewport, layout metrics report a 980px layout viewport, scale 0.367 and no viewport meta; the screenshot renders form text and controls extremely small.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a standards viewport meta tag and rebuild the form with intrinsic fluid layout, wrapping groups and responsive widths.

findings.summary: Many primary controls have undersized touch targets.
findings.evidence: The home probe found numerous 14–20px-high links/buttons; Lighthouse also fails target-size on the legacy search.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide at least 24×24 CSS px targets with spacing, preferably 44–48px for primary touch controls, while retaining visible focus.

findings.summary: HTTP failure states abandon users to the browser’s generic error page.
findings.evidence: A representative unknown route returned a bare browser HTTP 404 with only Reload, no portal navigation, explanation or recovery path.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a branded 404/error state with a clear explanation, home/search links, retry where relevant and announced status.

findings.summary: Primary pages load too slowly for the Core Web Vitals baseline.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 6.5s on the portal and 8.6s on the legacy search; the raw trace measured LCP 4.23s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the actual LCP content, remove client-render blocking, shorten dependency chains and verify LCP below 2.5s.

findings.summary: A simple service directory ships a disproportionate JavaScript payload and delayed dependency chain.
findings.evidence: HAR records 871KB transferred, including 711KB across six scripts; four app chunks account for about 707KB and LCP is delayed despite zero trace long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render useful content, split by route, remove unused/duplicate client code and avoid loading not-found code on the successful route.

findings.summary: The legacy search has unlabeled controls, missing alternatives and weak landmarks.
findings.evidence: The form probe found 15 visible controls without programmatic labels; Lighthouse fails form labels, image alt, link names, ARIA validity and main landmark.
findings.suggestedFix: Associate every input with a label, name icon controls, add meaningful/empty alt as appropriate and establish semantic landmarks.

findings.summary: The mobile rendering of the legacy search is not comfortably legible.
findings.evidence: The 980px desktop layout is reduced to 36.7% scale in a 360px viewport, making labels, inputs and instructions tiny.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive typography and form layout at native scale, with comfortable line height and no whole-page shrink.

findings.summary: Representative pages emit browser errors.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse’s errors-in-console audit fails on both the modern portal and legacy search; the HAR also records a 403 translation-resource request.
findings.suggestedFix: Resolve failed resources and runtime errors, and add monitoring/tests that fail on uncaught exceptions or console errors.

findings.summary: The legacy template uses quirks-era document and asset practices.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports no doctype, a deprecated API and low-resolution imagery on /cjpg; its best-practices score is 0.46.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HTML5 doctype and charset early, replace deprecated APIs, serve correctly sized images and remove inspector/BFCache blockers.

findings.summary: Public service pages lack consistent crawl and sharing signals.
findings.evidence: /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml return 404; /cjpg lacks a meta description; probes found no canonical, Open Graph or JSON-LD metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish robots.txt and sitemap, add canonical/description metadata per template, and provide accurate social/structured entity metadata.

findings.summary: Sensitive public-service routes lack browser defenses and set insecure session cookies.
findings.evidence: Both final pages omit CSP, HSTS, nosniff, framing, referrer and permissions policies. /cjpg sets JSESSIONID cookies without Secure, HttpOnly or SameSite protection.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite on session cookies and deploy CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking, referrer and permissions policies.

findings.summary: The legacy search sets long-lived legacy analytics cookies before user action.
findings.evidence: /cjpg sets __utma for 400 days plus several __utm cookies, all without Secure and with SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove legacy session-wide analytics, minimise events and retention, and use privacy-preserving batched measurement only when justified.

findings.summary: Authentication messaging still centres passwords and emailed OTP rather than phishing-resistant credentials.
findings.evidence: The primary banner says users sign in with username/password plus an emailed verification code; the platform probe found no PublicKeyCredential/navigator.credentials use in the loaded surface.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey/WebAuthn sign-in and reauthentication while retaining accessible recovery and existing MFA during migration.

findings.summary: Core portal content is absent without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability measured only 1% raw/rendered word coverage: raw HTML has 26 text characters versus 2,676 rendered and the crawler capture remains at a loading indicator.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the service directory and navigation as semantic links; hydrate only enhancements and provide usable no-JS fallbacks.

findings.summary: The legacy Portuguese page does not declare its language.
findings.evidence: The /cjpg DOM probe found an empty html lang while Lighthouse fails html-has-lang; the modern portal correctly uses pt-BR.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="pt-BR" on every template and keep layout based on logical properties for future bidi/translation resilience.

findings.summary: The legacy search offers weak input assistance and unclear validation semantics.
findings.evidence: The probe found no autocomplete tokens, many unlabeled fields and no exposed invalid/error state; a synthetic free-text query returned a huge generic result set rather than explaining the mismatch.
findings.suggestedFix: Label fields, use appropriate input/autocomplete modes, validate after interaction, announce specific errors and preserve entered values.

taskList.title: Secure every route with hardened session cookies and browser-enforced response policies.
Rebuild the legacy judgment-search template as a responsive, labelled, semantic form with humane validation.
Server-render public service content and publish complete crawl, canonical, sitemap and sharing metadata.
Reduce route JavaScript and critical dependency chains until LCP is consistently below 2.5 seconds.
Provide branded, actionable failure states and eliminate console/resource errors.
Add preference-driven dark mode and correct all text/control contrast failures.
Offer passkey/WebAuthn authentication alongside accessible recovery and migration support.
Use reduced-motion-aware View Transitions and position-aware navigation cues for service changes.
